name: MorphoBlue
fix_description: The constructor computes SCALE_FACTOR incorrectly, failing to account for the 12-decimal difference between PAXG (18 decimals) and USDC (6 decimals). Redeploy with correct constructor parameters to produce proper decimal normalization.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a short multi-step chain: take a flash loan, use Morpho Bundler multicall to supply collateral and overborrow via protocol-specific logic, then swap back to repay. It requires understanding Morpho authorization/bundler behavior plus Uniswap V2/V3 callbacks, so it is more than a trivial pattern but not a deeply complex cross-protocol attack.
